glue_rte_active_selection.description: Active model selection on the GLUE RTE benchmark at a 100-label budget, matching the paper's main cumulative-regret comparison for this task.

cumulative_regret_at_100.description: Total excess error incurred over the queried-label trajectory through the 100-label budget.

cumulative_regret_at_25.description: Early-label cumulative excess error through 25 queried labels, catching methods that only recover late.

cumulative_regret_at_50.description: Mid-budget cumulative excess error through 50 queried labels.

initial_regret.description: Zero-query excess error of the initially selected model.

instant_regret_at_50.description: Excess error of the selected model after 50 queried labels.

instant_regret_at_100.description: Excess error of the selected model after the full 100-label budget.

near_optimal_at_100.description: Whether the selected model is within one percentage point of the best candidate at the 100-label budget.

label_budget.description: Number of ground-truth labels consumed; improvements should not come from querying more labels.

num_models.description: Candidate pool size covered by the run, guarding against selecting from an easier reduced pool.

num_items.description: Evaluation item count covered by the run, guarding against scoring on a smaller benchmark.
